customers.evidence: we've worked to earn their trust, every single day.

employees.evidence: prioritizing the wellbeing of our employees and community members

environment.evidence: aligning business practices with societal and environmental imperatives

community.evidence: To help build a better world, where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams.

innovation.evidence: We've innovated to expand their opportunities.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, purpose-led framing centred on freedom of movement, dreams and a better world for society and future generations. Mostly first-person plural with some generic 'every person' language. Commitments are stated absolutely ('we do what we do best'). Stakeholder focus is broad societal; customers, employees and environment appear only briefly. Financial and safety themes are absent.
